predictions.B1: with the presolve, both groups converge (status Solved) within 200 iterations
predictions.B2: if B1 fails, 5,000 iterations suffice (status Solved) on the group(s) that failed at 200
predictions.B3: the converged x = 0 Q_LB lies within 1e-2 relative of Q_cert+ and containment holds
predictions.B4: P7: Q_LB(unit) <= Q_LB(x0) holds between converged values
predictions.B5: the Gurobi-convention stationarity residual <= 1e-6 relative at a converged point

operationalisation.converged: status == Solved (Clarabel 0.11.1, full tolerances); AlmostSolved is reported, counts as NOT converged for B1-B5, but triggers the containment STOP (conservative)
operationalisation.B1: solves x0.presolve.it200 and unit_n7.presolve.it200 both status Solved
operationalisation.B2: evaluated only if B1 FAILED: every group whose it200 solve is not Solved has its it5000 solve Solved; NOT APPLICABLE when B1 held (the it5000 solves are still run and reported)
operationalisation.B3: on the converged x0 it5000 solve (else the converged x0 it200 solve; else INDETERMINATE): Q_LB - Q_cert+ - solver gap <= 0 AND (Q_cert+ - Q_LB) / Q_cert+ <= 1e-2
operationalisation.B4: on the it5000 pair if both Solved (else the it200 pair if both Solved; else INDETERMINATE): Q_LB(unit) - Q_LB(x0) - gap(unit) - gap(x0) <= 0; every both-converged pair is reported
operationalisation.B5: at every Solved point: ||c - A'Pi - RC - sum_j QCPi_j grad q_j(x)||_inf / ||c||_inf <= 1e-6 with the mapping of `gurobi_convention_duals` (strict: the multipliers of the presolve rows have no image in the Gurobi convention -- the replaced quadratic row has a zero gradient at its apex -- and are NOT mapped). HELD iff every Solved point passes; INDETERMINATE if none is Solved. Reported beside it: the same residual with the presolve-row multipliers folded into RC as implicit fixings (labelled "folded"), and the residual restricted to columns no presolve row touches
operationalisation.gate_i: as in the smoke: |q.x_cert + const - (c.x_cert + ObjCon)| / |c.x_cert + ObjCon| <= 1e-12 and vs the T0.1c record <= 1e-12, on the PRESOLVED build
operationalisation.gate_ii_identity: as in the smoke on the presolved build; for each replaced cone |alpha (|s_bar|^2 - e t^2) - (q(x) - rhs)| <= 8 eps (|s_bar|^2 + e t^2 + sum|terms|) (s_bar the zero-row slacks)
operationalisation.gate_iii: G-D0-4 containment per solve: Q_LB - Q_cert+ - solver gap <= 0; a violation at a converged point (Solved / AlmostSolved) is a STOP (no further solve); at an unconverged point it is recorded, not a stop
operationalisation.per_solve_record: status, iterations, r_prim / r_dual and Clarabel info (res_primal, res_dual, gap_abs, gap_rel), objective, wall, the max LP-row violation of the returned point (linear / quadratic / bound, worst row), containment vs Q_cert+ (T0.1c objective.json), the dual residual ||q + A'z||_inf, the duality gap (Clarabel and recomputed), the Gurobi-convention stationarity residual (strict and folded), the small-circle activity
operationalisation.projection: 108 x the mean (setup + solve) wall of the converged solves of the smallest max_iter that converged, plus 72 group reads + builds; stated per iteration as well
